items.title: Image GPT
items.summary: We find that, just as a large transformer model trained on language can generate coherent text, the same exact model trained on pixel sequences can generate coherent image completions and samples. By establishing a correlation between sample quality and image classification accuracy, we show that our best generative model also contains features competitive with top convolutional nets in the unsupervised setting.
items.summaryZh: 该文章介绍了OpenAI开发的ImageGPT模型，研究人员发现将用于语言的大型Transformer模型直接训练在像素序列上，也能生成连贯的图像补全与样本。实验表明，该生成模型在无监督设置下具有与顶级卷积神经网络相竞争的特征提取和图像分类能力。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI发布ImageGPT，证明基于Transformer的语言建模方法同样适用于图像生成。
